subject: QoderWork fork_origin is sidecar-only, so post-July-2026 fork families degrade
description:
`QoderWorkAdapter::fork_origin` reads the relation from a sidecar file, so fork families
degrade to nothing for sidecar-less QoderWork sessions (post-July-2026 stores stopped
writing the sidecar). Code: `fork_origin` in claude-replay-agents/src/adapters.rs, delegating
to the QoderWork discover family.

BLOCKED ON EVIDENCE: needs a post-July-2026 FORK in the local QoderWork store to see where
the relation is now recorded. Candidate to check first: `sub_chats.ext`.

Softened, not urgent: the rail's title-clustering (#153) already groups most fork families
visually, so the user-visible damage is small.

Definition of done: a post-July fork located in the store, the new relation source read
in-band, and a fixture covering a sidecar-less fork family.
Design: design/qoderwork-fork-families.md. GitHub issue #32.
